turns.content: We settled on Pulumi for the infra. Looked at Terraform and CDK; Pulumi was the right pick because the team writes TypeScript already and the secrets handling is cleaner.
Pulumi-TypeScript fits the existing stack well.
Reviewing some old PRs — we used to talk about Terraform a lot before we picked the IaC tool. There's still a docs page that mentions it.
Worth cleaning up the docs reference if Terraform isn't the chosen tool.
